snippets.text: A FASTQ record is four lines: id, sequence, a plus line, and the quality line.
The quality line encodes one Phred score per base, one ASCII character each.
We store the Phred score plus 33, so even a score of zero stays a visible character.
A Phred score of 40 becomes the character I, and it means a 1 in 10,000 chance of a wrong base.
If the quality line is not the same length as the sequence line, the file is corrupt.
